Port-forward to Vault first: kubectl port-forward -n dojo-sec-vault svc/vault 8200:8200 & then set: export VAULT_ADDR=http://127.0.0.1:8200 VAULT_TOKEN=root
The flag is stored in Vault's KV store. Run: vault kv get secret/dojo/flag — look at the 'value' field in the output.

If vault CLI isn't installed locally, exec into the Vault pod: kubectl exec -n dojo-sec-vault $(kubectl get pod -n dojo-sec-vault -l app=vault -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- sh -c 'VAULT_ADDR=http://127.0.0.1:8200 VAULT_TOKEN=root vault kv get secret/dojo/flag'
